heading.home: Let’s talk about your pet’s habits.
body.home: The reviews on our website reflect our real customers’ personal experiences and include differing views. Discuss your own pet’s needs, the updates you would like and your grooming preferences with us before booking.
heading.services: Plan the service that suits your needs.
body.services: For boarding, specify arrival and departure dates; for grooming, tell us which treatments you would like. If you are considering several services, ask about their scope, availability and total cost in advance. You can call for current information on pet shop stock and the training and adoption processes.
body.hotel: Tell us about your pet’s usual food, mealtimes, rest routine and relationships with other animals. Ask in advance what to bring and about admission requirements. Agree on arrival and departure times, how you will receive updates during the stay and who should be contacted when needed.
heading.grooming: Share your grooming expectations before your appointment.
body.grooming: Describe the bath, scissor trim or styled cut you would like and your preferred coat length; share an example photo if you have one. Mention previous grooming experiences and any areas sensitive to touch. Discuss the planned treatments, estimated duration, price and what to do if your pet becomes unsettled.
heading.shop: Consider everyday habits when choosing products.
body.shop: Giving the brand and product name of the food you need, the pack size or accessory measurements makes it easier to ask for the right item. When choosing toys and accessories, tell us about your pet’s size and how they use them. Before visiting for a specific product, call to confirm current stock and price.
body.vet: This support is for pets staying with us. Please give us your regular vet’s contact details, the current follow-up plan and any special needs in advance. Before booking, discuss the documents required for admission, the scope of support and how we will contact you if a health issue arises.
body.training: Use specific examples to describe the everyday behaviours you would like to work on. During your enquiry, ask about the methods to be used, the session schedule, your involvement and exercises at home. Share your pet’s past experiences; clarify duration, scope and fees before starting.
heading.adoption: Take the first step with a shared life in mind.
body.adoption: Contact us first to learn about adoption availability and arrangements for meeting an animal. Consider the time you can devote to living with a pet, your home setup and the long-term responsibility for care. When meeting, ask about known habits and needs; seek information without assuming there is a current listing or a suitable animal available.
heading.reservation: Information to include in your enquiry.
body.reservation: Briefly describe your cat or dog’s age, the service you want, the dates and their daily habits. Include any special care needs and a number where we can reach you. Availability, service scope, total cost and drop-off and collection times are agreed through a conversation; this form alone does not create a booking.
